payload.title: Spike: block alignment and human-edit pinning without Markus block IDs
payload.description: Pure Python on fixtures, no deploy. Split a Markus body into blocks, align source blocks to target blocks by hash and position, pin blocks a person edited, then re-derive after source edits: paragraph added, removed, reordered, rewritten, split, merged. Report where alignment fails and whether stable Markus block identifiers are needed after all. Include Spanish, Chinese and Arabic fixtures. Plan: docs/plans/multilingual-publishing.md (PR #1450).
